Iris: Starting canary for cassia12b-int4 on pool-21. Seeing sporadic OOMs on long-summary workload and a small drop on our summarization eval (~2.0 ROUGE). Root shows allocator churn: `kv_alloc failed`
Theo: Config? prefetch, microbatch, max_new_tokens, slot_reserve?
Iris: prefetch=true, continuous_batching=true, microbatch=5, slot_reserve=0.05, max_new_tokens=360. Repro: 1.2k gen tokens; failures around 700-900 tokens.
Marta: Can you paste the allocator snippet? hypothesizing fragmentation rather than peak.
Iris: Node log snippet:
```
ERROR OOM kv_alloc
used=12.6GB free=0.35GB slot_frag=0.31
allocator: freelist_scan triggered=12 compacts=1
backtrace: ...
```
Theo: slot_frag 0.31 is high. Two quick non-invasive trials: A) prefetch=false + cap max_new_tokens=140; B) keep prefetch but enable `compact_on_evict=true` + set `freelist_defrag_threshold=0.12`. Which to run first?
Iris: Running A first — launching canary job 4951239877 with `curl -X POST https://canary/api/serve -d '{"model":"cassia12b-int4","opts":{"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":140}}'`
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for cassia12b-int4 on pool-21 (job 4951239877)
Marta: Also start a focused A/B: int4 vs hybrid-int8-attn (weights int4 but attention & kv in int8) on 500 summarization prompts. If hybrid recovers ROUGE, it's a quant-scale issue in attention/kv.
Iris: Update after 2k calls with prefetch off + max_new_tokens=140: zero OOMs, p50 latency +9-14ms, cost +6.5%. Starting hybrid-int8 AB now (job 4951239885).
Theo: Good. If hybrid-int8 matches float quality, we should consider a graded fallback: default int4 but auto-fallback attn/kv->int8 on long-gen traces or when slot_frag spikes. Also worth trying `kv_prealloc_window=64` to reduce alloc churn for long-gen flows.
Marta: Medium-term: enable `compact_on_evict`+increase `freelist_defrag_threshold` and run for 24h. Also add kernel-side defrag sweep during low-util windows (off-peak maintenance).
Iris: Adding automated gates: rollback if ROUGE drops >1.3 pts or OOM_rate >0.03% in pool-21. Also collecting `nvidia-smi` every 30s and allocator trace on any OOM.
Theo: For calibration: run per-channel scale recalibration for qkv and attention projection layers (calib set = 2k prompts). If that reduces the quality gap, we can keep int4 without hybrid fallback.
Marta: One more idea — trial microbatch=1 with `batch_size=1` and enable `generation_windowing=200` (flush kv more aggressively) to see if that lowers fragmentation on long-gen. Might trade latency but helps stability.
Iris: I'll run generation_windowing experiment next if hybrid AB doesn't fix quality. Posting AB numbers when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
